oneHealth.title: One Health Intelligence
oneHealth.subtitle: Disease risk signals computed live from health records across every farm on the platform
oneHealth.scanning: Scanning health records for risk signals...
oneHealth.aboutTitle: What this dashboard can and can't tell you
oneHealth.canDetect1: Health records naming a disease on an 18-entry zoonotic / major-transboundary watchlist (e.g. Anthrax, Rabies, Avian Influenza, Brucellosis, FMD, ASF, East Coast Fever) — matched against your full record history, not just recent ones.
oneHealth.canDetect2: Local/colloquial names too, not just clinical terms — e.g. "mad dog disease" for rabies, "Bang's disease" for brucellosis — plus typo-tolerant fuzzy matching on single-word terms.
oneHealth.canDetect3: Whether a match is confirmed, suspected, or just reported, based on the record's own wording — shown as a badge on each alert.
oneHealth.canDetect4: Actual deaths directly: recording an animal or record as Deceased now feeds a dedicated mortality-cluster detector, separate from (and more urgent than) the Critical-status one.
oneHealth.canDetect5: The same unnamed symptom reported across 3+ different farms in one district within 14 days — an early outbreak signal that needs no diagnosis at all.
oneHealth.canDetect6: A burst of 3+ Critical-status animals or records, or 2+ deaths, at one farm within 7 days.
oneHealth.whereWrongTitle: Where it can still be wrong
oneHealth.whereWrong1: A record now skips the watchlist match if it only mentions a preventive vaccination with no confirming or suspecting language — but it still trusts whatever wording is entered, so an ambiguous note can go either way.
oneHealth.whereWrong2: Fuzzy matching stays conservative (small edit-distance, single words only) to avoid false alarms — a genuinely novel term with no resemblance to any watchlist entry can still be missed.
oneHealth.whereWrong3: The cluster and mortality-spike detectors are intentionally window-bound (7–14 days), since a pattern from months ago isn't an active risk today — only the named-disease watchlist looks at full history.
oneHealth.noSignalsFullText: No watchlist diseases, critical clusters, or cross-farm outbreak patterns found in the last 30 days.
oneHealth.noAlertsMatchFilters: No alerts match the current filters.
